title: Chat surface cards from bricks' bx-surface; retire NERV's surface catalogue and renderer
goal: The four surface cards in chat render with @voidbrain/bricks' bx-surface, and NERV keeps no copy of the surface catalogue or renderer
acceptance: Chat surfaces (the four surface cards: lists, documents, cooking, photos producers) render through bricks' bx-surface in the workspace; web/src/surface-renderer.ts and the surface catalogue in shared/surface.ts are removed with their state, helpers and tests (no dead code)

Backend producers (src/lists.ts, src/documents.ts, src/cooking-pack.ts, src/cooking-session.ts) emit data that validates against bricks' surface schemas; a join test sends each surface kind from the producer through the API into bx-surface; POST /api/lists/toggle keeps working
A surface type bricks lacks is raised as a bricks proposal, not kept as a NERV copy

Owner decision 2026-11-26 (chat): "accept all 17 proposals" of the cross-project audit (coordinator docs/audits/2026-11-26-cross-project.md), proposal 13; for it the owner accepted the recommendation "use bricks' surface cards in F-130" (bricks:F-002-T02 ships the four surfaces with their schemas).
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface bricks cannot render goes to the owner before NERV keeps any copy

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 from the audit proposal: swap the renderer for bx-surface, validate four producers against the bricks schemas, delete the copies and their tests, one join test. Not a measurement.
